invalidation_reason.detail: Telegram evidence packets exposed final_value to the model. The frozen v0.14 preregistration explicitly required model-visible answer keys including final_value/final_answer/canonical answer aliases to be scrubbed before model exposure. In this diagnostic, the exposed terminal final_value matched the hidden benchmark final_answer on all 20 selected cases after oracle opening.
invalidation_reason.impact: The 20/20 OpenClaw score cannot be used as weaker-model efficacy evidence, cannot satisfy the v0.14 confirmatory gate, and must not be cited as a TERMINAL_AUTHORITY lift result.

next_valid_test: Run the same frozen 20-case Telegram evidence test with all model-visible answer keys scrubbed before exposure. Batch delivery is allowed; do not alter the selected cases or oracle answers.
